title: Affine presentation and charts of Sym(O plus F)
statement: For a scheme S and an O_S-module F [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], Presentation S F consists of quasi-coherent graded section algebra data [def-nagata-relative-proj], section algebra isomorphisms Sym_{O(V)}(O(V) × F(V)), their exact symmetric grading and restriction formulas. The distinguished coordinates t and x(m), chartOpen, affineTop, projectiveChart and chartMap are the existing definitions of the projective completion, with identical names and bodies. The projective-space chart uses [def-nagata-relative-projective-space] and homogeneous fractions use [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero].

source.place: Tags 01OA, 01OB, 01OE and 01NG; projective bundles and their standard affine charts

proof.text: Retain the existing seven definitions verbatim, moving them to a public data module to allow local lemmas to import their statements without a cycle. The chart maps remain the composite of Spec of the inverse dehomogenization, the standard Proj away immersion, and the relative Proj chart.
